name: agent-plugins
description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins: a Canvas LMS REST API subject-matter expert, a comment-free code style skill, and a meta-skill that scaffolds project-context skills.

plugins.name: no-ai-prose
plugins.description: Instructs agents to write prose without AI-telltale patterns: no em-dashes for drama, no filler openers, no transition-word inflation, and terse responses that omit scaffolding without sacrificing content.

plugins.name: canvas-lms-api
plugins.description: Subject-matter expert on the Canvas LMS REST API: 142 resources, ~1,078 endpoints, object models, plus guides for auth, pagination, SIS imports, LTI, Live Events, and RBAC permissions.

plugins.name: no-comment
plugins.description: Write comment-free code: no line/block comments, docstrings, TODOs, or banners, with narrow exceptions for functional directives and pragmas. Loads automatically at the start of every session.

plugins.name: project-skill-init
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new project-context skill (SKILL.md, a living PRD, a DESIGN stub, and an append-only ADR log with its own generator script) into any repository, following the pattern used by instructure-hosted-agents' hosted-agents skill.
